name: Snake Oil
summary: Party game where players invent absurd two-word products to sell to a role-playing customer who picks a favorite pitch.
rules_text: One player each round is the Customer: draw a Customer Card, reveal it, and role-play that character. Each other player holds six Word Cards. They secretly choose two from hand to combine into a product for this Customer and place them face down. Going clockwise, each seller reveals the two cards and has up to 30 seconds to pitch the product to the Customer, who may cut off long pitches. After all pitches, the Customer awards the Customer Card to the seller whose product they like best; that card is a point. Discard used Word Cards and draw back to six. The next player clockwise becomes Customer. Play continues until every player has been Customer once. Most Customer Cards wins; tie broken by one extra round with only tied sellers pitching to a non-tied Customer.
rating_reason: Pitch two-word product to customer - bluffing and judging text game.
